# Product Hunt launch — runbook

*Phase 3 of `growth-plan-2026-q4.md`. Prepared 2026-09-18. Everything a launch needs is in this file or generated by a committed script; nothing here is live until the Tech Lead schedules the listing.*

**Launch gate:** combined store ratings ≥ **25** (`marketing/site/store-ratings.json` — 15 on 2026-09-17: Play 4.9 × 14, App Store 5.0 × 1). Phase 2 set that threshold; PH traffic converts better against a listing that clears it. When the gate opens, launching is a single trigger — pick a Tue/Wed/Thu and work the checklist in §9.

---

## 1. Two corrections to the older docs (read first)

These were found while preparing this phase. Both affect what you do on launch day.

**1. Do not ask anyone to upvote.** `marketing-strategy.md` (§8) and `zero-budget-growth-plan.md` (Week 10) both say "line up 20 supporters who will upvote". Product Hunt's own rules forbid it: *"Asking or incentivizing people to upvote may trigger the algorithm to drop the product in the ranks or remove it from the homepage entirely."* PH's guidance is to ask for **feedback, comments, opinions and help spreading the word**. The templates in §6 are written that way. Sources: [PH help — can I ask friends to upvote?](https://help.producthunt.com/en/articles/484935-can-i-ask-my-community-friends-family-to-upvote-a-product), [PH — how to promote your launch](https://www.producthunt.com/launch/sharing-your-launch).

**2. `?ref=producthunt` is not something you wire — PH adds it — and our site ignores it.** Product Hunt reportedly appends `?ref=producthunt` to outbound links itself (that is where the growth plan's line comes from). `marketing/site/track.js` and `webAttribution.ts` only capture `rdt_cid` / `utm_*` and bail out unless `utm_source` or `rdt_cid` is present, so a bare `?ref=producthunt` would land as **Organic**. Put the tagged URL in the listing's website field (§3); PH's `ref` then rides along harmlessly. **Verify on launch morning** by hovering the live listing's website button — the reported PH behaviour is from third-party sources, not PH's docs.

*Checked 2026-09-18 by running the real `track.js` against stubbed browser state:* the tagged link is captured and carried into the Play `referrer` and the web-app link; PH's appended `&ref=producthunt` changes nothing; a bare `?ref=producthunt` is dropped (no campaign). If the tagged URL is ever forgotten, those visits still record `referrer_host = 'www.producthunt.com'` in `analytics_events` — findable by querying the table, though the report won't attribute them.

## 2. What's ready

| Asset | Location | Spec |
|---|---|---|
| Gallery, 6 cards | `social-media/product-hunt/ph-gallery-01…06-*.png` | 1270×760 (PH's recommended size), 117–268 KB each |
| Thumbnail | `social-media/product-hunt/ph-thumbnail.png` | 240×240 |
| Demo video | `social-media/product-hunt/vacationist-product-hunt-demo.mp4` | 60.00 s, 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264, silent |
| Attribution | `trackFeatureEvent.ts` forwards `utm_*` on activation events | see §8 |
| Report | `npm run analytics:report -- --campaign=ph-launch-2026` | see §8 |

Regenerate: `npm run assets:producthunt` (gallery + thumbnail). The video is `scripts/generate-producthunt-video.mjs` — ffmpeg is not a repo dependency; see the script header (`npm i ffmpeg-static` in a scratch dir, pass `--ffmpeg=<path>`).

Gallery order (PH shows the first image in the feed, so the hero leads): **01 hero** · 02 vote · 03 split · 04 flights · 05 calendar · 06 "Free. No ads. Works offline."

Every product claim on the cards and in the video is one the site already makes (`/features/offline/`, the homepage TL;DR). Don't add claims that aren't on the site first.

**Not in the gallery, deliberately:** the "Prework" preferences screen (dense, dark, hard to read at thumbnail size). It's in `play-store/screenshots/` if you want an extra slot — PH allows up to 8.

## 3. Listing copy

**Name:** Vacationist

**Tagline** — PH's tagline field is short (60 characters is the commonly cited cap; confirm in the form). Lengths measured:

| # | Tagline | Chars |
|---|---|---|
| 1 ★ | The group trip planner that replaces WhatsApp polls | 51 |
| 2 | Group trip planning without the WhatsApp chaos | 46 |
| 3 | Vote, split costs and plan group trips — free, no ads | 53 |
| 4 | Plan group trips together: vote, split, stay in sync | 52 |

★ Recommended. The plan's canonical line — *"The group trip planner that replaces Splitwise + Wanderlog + WhatsApp polls"* — is **75 characters**, over the cap. Use it in the first comment instead, where it reads as a sentence.

**Description** (PH limit 260; this is 217):

> A free group trip planner for iOS, Android and web. Vote on activities, split expenses with receipts, keep flights and tickets with the trip, and work offline for a week. Guests join with one link — no account needed.

(244-character alternative: same idea, adds "and stay in sync — even offline". Either is within the limit.)

**Website field:** `https://vacationist.app/?utm_source=producthunt&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=ph-launch-2026`

**Additional links:** Play Store, App Store (`https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vacationist/id6800049398`) — plain store URLs. PH visitors on desktop are more likely to try the web app first (`https://web.vacationist.app`), which is also the only surface where activation is measurable (§8) — add it too.

**Topics** — PH's guidance is a few that most strongly relate. Suggested: **Travel**, **Productivity**, **Android**, **iOS** (pick from what PH's picker actually offers).

**Video:** PH accepts **YouTube links only, full URL (no shortened links)** — not uploads. Upload the MP4 to YouTube first.
- Title: `Vacationist — the free group trip planner (60-second demo)`
- Description: one line on what it is + `https://vacationist.app/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=ph-launch-2026`

**Pricing / "is it free forever?" — decide before launch, don't improvise live.** The truthful answer today is: free, no ads, no paywall in the product. `growth-plan-2026-q4.md` Decision 1 says a paid tier is planned around ~500 MAU, and the site copy was deliberately scrubbed of Pro claims in Phase 1. Someone *will* ask. Agree the exact wording now. A safe shape: *"Free today with no ads. If I ever add a paid tier it would be for extras, not to take away what you're already using."* — but that last clause is a business commitment, so it's the Tech Lead's call, not this doc's.

## 4. Maker first comment (draft)

PH's own guide has no template for this, and nothing in the repo did either. The origin story is the one part only you can write — readers can tell when it's generic, so it's left as a placeholder rather than invented.

> Hi Product Hunt 👋 I'm **[name]**, the developer behind Vacationist.
>
> **[YOUR STORY — one or two sentences: the real trip, group chat or spreadsheet that made you build this.]**
>
> Vacationist is a free group trip planner that replaces the pile of tools a group usually juggles — polls in one chat, expenses in another app, the plan in a spreadsheet. (If you know the alternatives: think Splitwise + Wanderlog + WhatsApp polls, in one place.)
>
> • **Vote on activities** — the whole group votes and what wins gets locked in
> • **Split expenses** — simplified settlements, a spending breakdown, receipts attached
> • **Flights, tickets, stays and packing lists** live in the same shared trip
> • **Works offline for a week**, then syncs by itself
> • **Passport details encrypted** (AES-256) and unlocked with biometrics
> • **Guests join with one link** — no account needed
>
> It's on iOS, Android and the web, free today with no ads, built in Switzerland.
>
> I'd love to hear **[one specific question — e.g. "what's the most annoying part of planning a trip with friends?"]**. I'm here all day and will answer every comment.

Post it the moment the listing goes live. PH's own advice: your two most important launch-day jobs are getting the word out and *"being accessible to the community by responding to comments in real time."*

**Prepared answers** (facts, so nobody improvises them at 9 a.m.):

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Do I need an account to join a trip? | No — anyone can join via an invite link. |
| Is my passport data safe? | Travel-document fields are encrypted (AES-256) and unlocked with biometrics; they're deliberately not cached on-device, so they need a connection to open. |
| Does offline really work? | Read the cached plan and keep adding expenses/votes/list items for at least 7 days with no connection; queued changes send themselves on reconnect. Not available offline: the encrypted document vault. |
| How is it different from Splitwise / Wanderlog? | Use the pre-verified pages `/vs/splitwise/` and `/vs/wanderlog/` — don't make competitor claims from memory. |
| Is it free forever? | See the pricing note in §3 — agree the wording first. |

## 5. UTM scheme (state it once, use it everywhere)

One **campaign** for the whole launch, a different **source** per channel, so `--campaign=ph-launch-2026` gives the full launch picture and the source chart splits it by channel.

| Where the link lives | `utm_source` | `utm_medium` |
|---|---|---|
| PH listing website field | `producthunt` | `launch` |
| YouTube video description | `youtube` | `video` |
| LinkedIn post (first comment) | `linkedin` | `social` |
| Reddit / other communities | `reddit` | `social` |
| Email to your own contacts | `email` | `email` |

All with `utm_campaign=ph-launch-2026`, on `https://vacationist.app/`. DACH-language posts should link `https://vacationist.app/de/` with the same params.

**First-touch wins:** `track.js` stores the *first* tagged visit per browser and never overwrites it. Someone who arrived from a Reddit ad last month and then comes via PH stays credited to Reddit. That is correct behaviour, not a bug — but it means launch numbers are a floor for "people PH influenced".

---

## 6. Supporter outreach (compliant)

Personal messages to people who'd genuinely use the app, sent one at a time — not a broadcast. **Do not ask for upvotes** (§1). Ask for feedback. Send on launch morning with the live link (there is no shareable link before the listing is scheduled/live), or the evening before with "tomorrow" and no link.

> Hey **[name]** — I'm launching Vacationist on Product Hunt today: **[link]**. It's the group trip planner I built to replace polls-in-a-chat and expense spreadsheets.
>
> I'm not asking for votes — a genuine comment or question is worth far more to me. If you've got a minute, what would make you use this for your next group trip? And what's missing?

Notes:
- Supporters should use their **real, existing PH accounts**. Brand-new throwaway accounts that appear only to comment risk looking like manipulation.
- Don't run any contest or incentive tied to votes — PH says that can get the launch un-featured.
- Aim for ~20 individual messages, per the plan — as feedback requests.

---

## 7. Launch day

PH's day starts at **12:01 AM Pacific**. That is **09:01 in Switzerland** (a 9-hour gap all year, except **08:01** between 25 Oct and 1 Nov 2026 when EU and US clocks are out of step) — so you're awake for it. Pick **Tue, Wed or Thu**; avoid US Thanksgiving week (26 Nov 2026).

| When (CH time) | Do |
|---|---|
| Night before | Listing scheduled and previewed; video on YouTube; gallery uploaded; first comment saved in a note; UTM links tested |
| 08:00 | LinkedIn "why I built this" post — **no link in the body** (`zero-budget-growth-plan.md`: LinkedIn suppresses posts with external links; its playbook also wants a Tue–Thu, 7–9 am post) |
| 08:45 | Confirm the listing is live. Hover the website button — confirm the destination carries `utm_source=producthunt` (§1) |
| 09:01 | Post the maker first comment on PH (§4) |
| 09:05 | Add the PH link as the **first comment** on the LinkedIn post (the playbook says ~5 min after posting; here the link simply doesn't exist until the listing is live). Then send the personal supporter messages (§6) |
| 09:30 | Communities where you're **already active** (PH's own advice) — check each subreddit's self-promotion rule first; post in German for DACH communities, in natural German, not a translation (see the `german-copy-natural-not-literal` skill) |
| All day | Answer every comment quickly. Reply to comments on the LinkedIn/community posts too |
| Evening | `npm run analytics:report -- --days=1 --campaign=ph-launch-2026` — first read (§8) |

## 8. Measurement

```bash
npm run analytics:report -- --days=3 --campaign=ph-launch-2026
```

The report scopes every view to the campaign: visits → store/web-app clicks → sign-ups, the web-app activation funnel, sources split by channel, and "Trips created" per campaign.

**What changed this phase:** before, `trip_created` / `invite_sent` / `invite_accepted` / `expense_added` carried **no** attribution — a campaign was measurable only as far as `sign_up`. `trackFeatureEvent.ts` now forwards the stored `utm_*`, so activation is attributable.

**Read these numbers as a floor.**
- **Consent-gated:** only visitors who accept the cookie banner are counted, and PH's audience skews to ad blockers.
- **Web app only:** activation events fire from `web.vacationist.app` alone. Someone who installs the **iOS** app from a PH click is invisible after the store click — the App Store passes no referrer, and iOS sign-up attribution is intentionally not sent. Android gets the Play install-referrer handoff. For installs, cross-check **App Store Connect** and **Play Console** for the launch days.
- **Earlier trips carry no campaign:** only activation events fired after this change ships are attributable.
- **Prod only after deploy:** attribution starts counting once the web app on `main` is redeployed (push to `main` → Vercel). No migration or Edge Function change was needed.

**Success is not upvotes.** The metric that matters (per `zero-budget-growth-plan.md`) is trips created and invites accepted from people you don't know — the K-factor signal. Rank by that.

After the launch, resubmit `sitemap.xml` in Search Console if the site changed.

## 9. Things only the Tech Lead can do

In order. Items 1–4 have lead time; do them before the launch week.

**Before launch**

1. **Play Console — update the store listing** (short description, full description, "What's new") from `play-store/listing.md`, which was refreshed this phase. The live listing text predates offline mode, receipts, analytics/trip costs and business expenses. Check the DE locale too (`Vacationist Gruppenreiseplaner`).
2. **App Store Connect — same content**, EN + DE. Confirm the subtitle still matches the Decision-2 listing names.
3. **Reviews to 25 — the launch gate.** `npm run reviews:outreach` lists real users at a genuine success moment (8 not yet app-nudged as of 2026-09-17). Make personal asks — this is the same "ask for genuine feedback" rule as §6. Then `npm run ratings:sync`, **verify the numbers by eye against both consoles**, `npm run build:site`, and commit. The homepage rating line and `aggregateRating` JSON-LD light up together at 25.
4. **Play ratings automation** — retry `npm run ratings:sync -- --play-bucket=pubsite_prod_4871205259084418605`. The service-account permission was already verified correct; only Play's backend propagation (reported up to ~24 h) was pending. **Don't re-debug the grant.** A first success also validates the unverified CSV header assumptions in `parseRatingsOverviewCsv()`.
5. **Deploy the attribution fix** — push to `main` so `web.vacationist.app` serves the new `trackFeatureEvent`. Do this **before** launch day, not on it. Then verify (Verification below).
6. **Upload the video to YouTube** — full URL, not a short link.
7. **Product Hunt** — maker profile, product page, gallery + thumbnail, topics, links, video, schedule. Fill in the two placeholders in §4.
8. **Decide the pricing wording** (§3) and write the two placeholders in the first comment (§4).
9. **~20 individual supporter messages** drafted (§6). Feedback asks, not vote asks.

**Launch day** — §7.

**After** — thank-you messages to everyone who commented; read the report; note what worked in `growth-plan-2026-q4.md`.

---

## Verification (attribution) — do once before launch

1. Open `https://web.vacationist.app/?utm_source=producthunt&utm_campaign=ph-launch-2026` in a fresh browser profile, **accept the cookie banner**, sign in, create a trip.
2. Confirm the new `trip_created` row in prod `analytics_events` has `utm_source = 'producthunt'` and `utm_campaign = 'ph-launch-2026'`.
3. Run `npm run analytics:report -- --days=1 --campaign=ph-launch-2026` — the campaign should show **Trips created ≥ 1**.
4. Delete the test trip/rows if you don't want them in the launch numbers.
